description: From the West Virginia Citizens Defense League: "WVCDL is proud to endorse Wayne Clark for House of Delegates in the Republican primary. WVCDL evaluates candidates based on their commitment to the rights of law-abiding West Virginians, using surveys and legislative histories when applicable.We encourage all voters to learn more about these candidates and to participate in the upcoming primary elections if eligible."
title: Endorsed by the WV CDL
